authorization: User requested iterative improvement and a paper of at most 15 pages. No external submission or full factory expansion.

page_limit.supplement: Separate reproducibility artifact; essential evidence and limitations remain in the main paper.

preservation.implementation: New research code and results live under revision/. Original frozen scientific code and original reports remain unchanged.

central_question: Can executable synthetic temporal workflows reduce verified-history supervision needed for useful operational history repair, while controlling damage to correct histories?
phases: Audit baseline implementations, annotation accounting, and fresh cohort availability.

Prepare identifier-disjoint revision-development, annotation-pool, and sealed confirmation partitions from remaining BPI2017 and BPI2019 records. Exclude original audited prefixes and original confirmation objects. Record same-source dependence.

Develop fully accounted nested total annotation budgets, allocating both fitting and calibration within each budget. Compare real-only, synthetic-only, original-synthetic-plus-real, and varied-synthetic-plus-real using identical real labels.
Run a separate published-method comparison on missing single case identifiers, preserving the published model's closed-vocabulary setting and documenting every implementation or protocol adaptation.
Investigate repair harm on development data. Any new decoder must beat a matched confidence-threshold control on useful recovery at comparable damage before adoption.

Audit public independently labelled natural fragmentation/error sources for a compatible supplementary case study. Do not manufacture natural-error ground truth or substitute injected errors without labelling them.
Freeze revised methods and exact evaluation jobs before opening fresh confirmation outcomes. Preserve every declared comparison and negative result.
Write, compile, visually review, and verify a manuscript of at most 15 total pages with reproducible supporting artifacts.

annotation_plan.unit: One completely verified root-object history bundle, including its associated target child objects and their alias handles; report events, target identities, and fitting/calibration splits as well.
annotation_plan.nonzero_split: Three quarters fitting, one quarter calibration, nested within each allocation seed.
critical_limits: Existing method-development labels are historical research costs, not zero. A new-domain adaptation budget must be named as such.
Controlled labels obtained from released references simulate annotation access; no claim of measured human minutes without a human study.
Never use labels of unselected histories to assign training or calibration targets.
Previously inspected original outcomes are development evidence for revision decisions, not fresh confirmation.

success_and_rejection_rules: Adopt a reduced-supervision claim only if matched comparisons support it across both application families; retain negative budget and damage results.
Do not adopt a more complex decoder merely because it is new; compare against the original decoder with validation-selected thresholds.
Treat published native-method reproduction, adapted comparisons, and generic controls as distinct.
Natural-error validation requires an independent reference and a compatible observation contract. If unavailable, disclose the remaining limitation.
Do not claim universal superiority, guaranteed safety, a new general domain-randomization principle, or guaranteed acceptance.
If the key new experiments reject the intended claim, revise the scientific scope or method using development evidence before any new held-out test.
